summary: AUTODET-1-2 contract interrogated against the approved plan, decision 0121, and the landed stage-1 diff (ec121aa1e). The integration proof must exercise the real finalization/readiness path over Postgres, and the card-grant-resume loop must use the existing SCHED-4B approve-from-card machinery, not a repository shortcut that skips the pause card. Re-grilled after the proof loop: required-test ids corrected to exact JUnit names; the integration command carries GANTRY_TEST_DATABASE_URL inline (worker sandbox cannot reach any Postgres - orchestrator runs the proof). Root cause of 3 failed rounds: test deps lacked getToolRepository so readiness preflight silently saw no bindings - fixed with one dep line; product smell (silent undefined tool repository in readiness) noted for review lens.
gaps: JUnit name-exactness trap (hit in stage 1): required-test ids must equal the vitest JUnit testcase names including describe-chain prefixes, or stage done refuses
The integration test could fake the grant by writing the binding row directly, which would not prove the card-grant-resume loop
The no-auto_classifier assertion needs a concrete event source to grep in-test (runtime events for the run), not log scraping
resolutions: Implementer verifies the junit testcase names after writing the tests; the orchestrator corrects decomposition ids to the exact names before stage done if prefixed (proven stage-1 procedure)

Required flow pinned: deny -> paused job with setup card -> grant via the same path the card's request_access recovery invokes -> resume -> reviewed-rule allow -> completion; direct repository writes only for fixture setup, never for the grant under test
Assert on the run's persisted permission decision events (decidedBy values) captured through the test harness event sink
open_items: If the pause-card copy assertion is already covered by an existing execution-finalization test, extending it is preferred over a new file
